To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the reliability of a system can be increased at an optimum rate by increasing the cost of the system at the same rate.

the optimum design of reliable systems with respect to life cycle cost is a function of: (1) the cost vs reliability function for the system and its components; (2) the reliability vs life function for the system; (3) the reliability of the system; and (4) the life of the system.

The life cycle cost of a series reliability structure is a function of the failure rate of the individual components, the cost of each component, the number of components in each series structure, and the cost and time of repair of each series structure.
